title: Tags
description: Maps each namespaced registry to its namespaced tags and their resolved, namespaced members. Nested #tag references are flattened by the generator, so members are always concrete entries.

minecraft:block.description: Tags over the block registry (e.g. minecraft:mineable/pickaxe, minecraft:needs_iron_tool).

minecraft:item.description: Tags over the item registry (e.g. minecraft:pickaxes, minecraft:logs).

^[a-z0-9_.-]+:[a-z0-9/._-]+$.description: Any additional namespaced registry the generator emits, including path-shaped registries such as minecraft:worldgen/biome.

tagMap.description: Maps a namespaced tag name to its resolved, namespaced member names. Empty member lists are valid because vanilla ships empty tags.
